name: Bramley & Gage 6 O'clock Gin
expressions: Bramley & Gage Sloe Gin | local sloes steeped in Bramley & Gage gin with sugar
serve_official: Copa glass, plenty of ice, classic tonic, twist of lemon peel
notes: BACKLOG MISMATCH: 6 O'clock Gin is a dry gin, not a sloe gin. The sloe product is the separate 'Bramley & Gage Sloe Gin'. Brand began on a fruit farm in South Devon, now distilled in Bristol. Bottle is Bristol-blue glass.
